description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named StoreBrandingController responsible for handling store branding related administrative web pages. It provides endpoints for displaying the branding page, saving branding images, updating templates, and removing store logos. The controller interacts with services related to merchant stores, content management, and auxiliary reference data.

classes.name: StoreBrandingController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing store branding settings, such as store logos and templates, within the admin backend.

methods.name: displayStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store branding page, preparing model attributes including templates and store information.

methods.name: saveStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new store logo image, uploading the logo and updating the store entity.

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the store’s template selection.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX requests to remove the store logo image.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set navigation menu context for the view.
